headline: Congress taking a long weekend as both chambers adjourn early with no votes or major action on Friday.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session for fewer than one minute at 10:00 a.m. on Friday, September 4, before adjourning until Tuesday. No legislative business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly at 10:00 a.m. and adjourned just two minutes later. Six public bills and two resolutions were introduced, but the chamber took no votes and conducted no floor business.
